## Code Review

This pull request adds a check in the oneshot entrypoint to ensure a distributed process group is initialized when running in a torchrun environment, raising a ValueError if not. The feedback recommends correcting the error message to use standard Python dot notation and referencing the correct module path, compressed_tensors.offload.init_dist(), for better accuracy.
